name: CoronaCidades
content: Problems and Purpose CoronaCidades is made up of specialists in various areas of policy and management, who organize dialogues to discuss the evolution of the COVID-19 pandemic, and analyze the policies implemented by certain municipalities. Furthermore, the CoronaCiudades' team prepares guides with policy recommendations for the municipalities, with concrete measures for the health emergency context.
